meta.name: product-photography
meta.description: AI product photography with studio lighting, lifestyle shots, and packshot conventions. Covers angles, backgrounds, shadow types, hero shots, and e-commerce image requirements. Use for: product photos, e-commerce images, Amazon listings, packshots, lifestyle photography. Triggers: product photography, product photo, packshot, e-commerce photography, product shot, product image, studio photography, lifestyle product, amazon product photo, product listing image, hero shot, product mockup, commercial photography

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成专业级电商产品照片，含多种布光和场景
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为电商产品制作高质量照片
copy.tagline_en: Generate professional e-commerce product photos with studio lighting and lifestyle shots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need high-quality product photos for e-commerce

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过命令行生成专业产品照片，包括纯白背景的电商图、生活场景图、特写图等，并支持调整角度、光线和阴影。
howto.when: 当你提到“产品摄影”、“电商图片”、“亚马逊产品图”等关键词，或要求生成产品照片时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一张白色背景的蓝牙耳机产品图。
为这款咖啡杯生成一张生活场景图，放在木桌上。
say.note: 会生成 lifestyle 风格的产品照片。

say.text: 生成一张手表特写，突出表盘纹理。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate professional product photos via command line, including white-background e-commerce images, lifestyle shots, close-ups, etc., with control over angles, lighting, and shadows.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "product photography", "e-commerce images", "Amazon product photo", or ask to generate product photos.

say_en.text: Generate a white background product shot of a Bluetooth speaker.
say_en.note: Calls Seedream model for a clean packshot.

say_en.text: Create a lifestyle image of this coffee mug on a wooden table.
Produce a close-up of a watch dial showing texture.
